statement: The independent device-side emulator and PR16's Dolphin camera approximation are insufficient to establish retail Wii Remote full-IR blob intensity unit, scale, saturation and interaction with size/bounds. Requires clean independent hardware observations or a verified firmware/IR sensor decoding reference; no claim of physical intensity fidelity can be promoted from approximate emulator models.

applicability.revision: Retail IR camera revisions not measured
applicability.scope: Full IR mode native blob metadata, not the already documented basic/extended packing.
